$comment: English strings. Key parity with es/ui.json is enforced by scripts/validar-contenido.mjs.

sitio.entradilla: Gym exercises explained with a 3D figure.

vis.respaldo_3d: This scene needs 3D. The text explanation is below.

favoritos.vacio: Nothing saved yet. The star on each card saves it on this device.
favoritos.entradilla: What you have saved on this device.

figura.sin_3d: Your browser can't show the figure. The step-by-step is below.
figura.roles_origen: The roles describe the movement as technique manuals define it. They are not a measurement of how much each muscle works: that depends on the variant, the load and how it is measured.

aviso.salud: This explains how an exercise is done, not whether it suits you. If you have an injury, pain or any medical condition, check with a professional first.

registro.rir_ayuda: RIR: reps you had left in reserve when you finished the set. Optional.
registro.error: Check the numbers: that set can’t be saved.
registro.vacio: You haven’t logged any sets of this exercise yet. What you log is saved on this device only.
registro.unorm_nota: 1RM is an estimate from the Epley and Brzycki formulas, not a lift: there’s no need to test it.
registro.unorm_aviso: It comes from a set of more than {n} reps, where the formulas lose accuracy.
registro.tus_datos: Back up and restore your data

datos.entradilla: What you save in befit lives on this device only. From here you can take it to another one.
datos.exportar_texto: Download a file with your favourites and your log. Keep it wherever you like: befit doesn’t send it anywhere.
datos.importar_texto: Choose a befit backup file. It’s added to what you already have here: nothing is deleted.
datos.importado: Backup restored. New favourites: {favoritos}. New sets: {series}.
datos.error_formato: That file isn’t a befit backup.
datos.error_version: That backup comes from a newer version of befit. Update the app and try again.
datos.borrar_texto: Deletes your favourites and your whole log from this device. It can’t be undone, so make a backup first.

pie.creditos: 3D figure by Quaternius (CC0) · Muscle map from body-muscles (Apache 2.0) · Inter and Newsreader typefaces (SIL OFL)
